The '''''Emperor's Glory''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]]<ref name="Esseles" /> that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy's]] [[Imperial Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]],<ref name="Maelstrom" /> under the command of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Esseles" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Lost">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref> the ''Emperor's Glory'' attacked the [[Wanderer-class transport|''Wanderer''-class transport]] [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] so that Kilran could capture the Republic ambassador [[Vyn Asara]] and from this vessel he sent Imperials and Mandalorians onto ''Esseles''.<ref name="Esseles" /> In the battle, it [[The Barsen'thor|was]] [[Hero of Tython|boarded]] [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|by]] [[Voidhound|individuals]] from the ''Esseles, ''and its tractor beam shut down, allowing ''Esseles'' to escape. After failing to capture Ambassador Asara, it later led the Fifth Fleet in [[Battle of the Maelstrom|ambushing]] the [[First Expeditionary Fleet]] in [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], but the [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Oteg]] was able to destroy the ''Glory'' with the combined firepower of his fleet.<ref name="Maelstrom" />
